We are looking for an Operator Machining to join the Machining department and machine aluminium profiles using pre-set turning and/or milling machines. 
This is a hands-on production position where you will work with both series production and individual products. Do you have an eye for accuracy and quality, and are you comfortable working in shifts? Then this position is a great fit for you. 
What will you do? 
- Read work instructions and technical drawings 
- Check aluminium profiles for quantity, dimensions and visible damage 
- Operate turning and/or milling machines 
- Position products and clamps correctly in the machine 
- Monitor the machining process and product quality 
- Measure products with tools such as calipers, measuring tape and squares 
- Perform first-product and sample inspections 
- Register completed production orders and cycle times 
- Solve minor machine issues where possible 
- Perform basic machine maintenance and cleaning 
- Report technical or quality deviations to the Team Leader Over het bedrijf
